283308aac517dcc1f1e51df85c78cf4f6f45194e.rationale: elevated IgG4 levels and imaging findings consistent with hypophysitis

IgG4-related hypophysitis: No other organ involvement identified on systemic imaging could be seen as not fully supporting systemic nature of IgG4-related disease, but presence of lung lesion and pituitary involvement is consistent with the diagnosis
Gonadotropin, thyroid, and adrenal axis deficiencies and severe GH deficiency confirmed by dynamic pituitary stimulation tests
Pituitary MRI showed diffuse swelling of the pituitary body and stalk
7-mm poorly enhancing mass in the right anterior lobe on pituitary MRI
Loss of the posterior pituitary bright spot on T1-weighted images
Thickening of the sphenoid sinus mucosa on pituitary MRI
Nodular lesion in the left lung field on chest CT
